title: Zero bad restriction weight at width zero
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\varphi$ be a disjunctive normal form on $n$ sign variables, and suppose its width is zero. For every real $\delta$, the total weight of restrictions on which $\varphi$ is nonconstant is zero.
hypotheses_covered: A disjunctive normal form on those coordinates
